svg.title: MagicPilot LIVE on the Tab5, labelled
svg.desc: Photo of MagicPilot LIVE in the PRO view on an M5Stack Tab5, showing the camera's live HDMI picture of a model steam engine, labelled. Top bar: the frame icon opens the display tools and shows LUT while the camera's display LUT is on; the PRO buttons CLEAN FEED to FALSE COLOR switch these on the camera's HDMI output; FPS, SHUTTER and IRIS, and ISO, WB and TINT are the camera's values, tap one to change it; the timecode shows TC or the clip counter and is red while recording; the Bluetooth symbol is blue while connected; CAM shows the camera's power, AC or battery; the settings icon opens the menu; M5 Tab shows the Tab5's power, USB-C or battery; VIEW switches between LITE and PRO. Bottom bar: the slate; CODEC/QUALITY shows the recording format; PRESET opens the 12 camera presets; the record button starts and stops recording; play shows the camera's clips; the card slots CFast, SD and SSD show the recording time left; FOCUS is a slider from NEAR to FAR; AF runs the camera's one-shot autofocus. The HDMI capture adapter's cable is plugged into the Tab5's USB-A port, and power into its USB-C port.
